name: What is the process for replacing windows in an older home?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing windows in an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally begins with an initial consultation and measurement of existing window openings. After selecting your new windows, they are ordered, which can take several weeks. Once the windows arrive, the installation team prepares the area by protecting flooring and furnishings. Old windows are carefully removed, and new frames are installed, leveled, and sealed to ensure airtightness. Finally, trim and finishing work are completed, followed by a thorough cleanup.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, ordering, removal of old windows, installation of new ones, sealing, finishing, and cleanup.
